description: Ports du Maroc is a data set listed in Africa GeoPortal (Esri), a continental ArcGIS Hub, published or maintained by Geomatic (the credit line on the item; item owner Geomatic_content). Le Maroc se distingue par un double littoral maritime d'une longueur d'environ 3.500km. Il dispose de 39 ports répartis comme suit: 13 ports ouverts au commerce extérieur: NADOR, AL HOCEIMA, TANGER, TANGER-MED, KENITRA, MOHAMMEDIA, CASABLANCA, JORF LASFAR, SAFI, AGADIR, TANTAN, LAAYOUNE, DAKHLA 10 ports de pêche à vocation régionale RAS KEBDANA, EL JEBHA, M’DIQ, LARACHE ... Coverage: Morocco. The portal's own publisher field holds an unfilled template placeholder; the item credit reads Geomatic and the item owner is Geomatic_content. Its tags are Ports, Maroc, Morocco. The portal shows 2018-05-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is custom rights statement written on the portal listing (long text, see the linked page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record platform-africa-geoportal-esri.
